name: Maximilian Gruber
bio:
Maximilian's analytical mind and passion for motorsport converged early in his life. Growing up near the Red Bull Ring, he was captivated by the precision and financial strategy required to keep a racing team competitive. He holds a degree in finance from the Vienna University of Economics and Business, and his early career involved auditing high-growth tech startups. 

He joined Anderson Racing two years ago, bringing a fresh perspective on cost optimization and resource allocation. Maximilian believes in a data-driven approach to financial management, constantly seeking innovative ways to improve efficiency and profitability. He's known for his ability to identify hidden opportunities and potential risks, ensuring the team's financial stability and enabling them to invest in crucial areas like research and development.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight side part.
physical.description: Maximilian has a focused gaze and an air of quiet confidence.

quirks: Always carries a small, vintage calculator.
Prefers to conduct meetings standing up.
Has a peculiar habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
